title: ChannelMessageInData
description: data of channel.message_in (PRD 9.5). A message from a bound WhatsApp number or to Tilo's email address. Never the body: message_ref points at the redacted raw archive record (PRD 13.2). card_id is set when the message answers a card; card_kind is then that card's kind, copied by the channels service from the card, and null otherwise. option is the id of the card option the person tapped (a WhatsApp reply button), taken from the button's payload; null when the person typed the message. destination is the thread or folder the message was sent about (an email thread forwarded to Tilo, or the one the card it answers showed), as an opaque id set by the channel, never read out of the text by a model; null otherwise (BQ-29). For whatsapp, actor is the user whose number is bound and confirmed (FR-CHN-03), looked up after the webhook signature check. An L2 policy acts only on the destination its owner's instruction names (policy.applied instruction_id, OB-01), and counts this event as that instruction only when channel is whatsapp, option is null (the owner's own typed words) and card_kind is null or needs_you (BQ-56): a tapped option, such as Hold on a gate card, and any answer to a gate, consent or meeting card is recorded by its own answering event and is never an instruction. An email's sender is not authenticated, so an email is never an instruction, whoever its actor is.
